spec.hypothesis: Inventory-aware quoting reduces average absolute inventory; its mean net P&L advantage over fixed quoting is uncertain. Parameters and sample size are fixed before observing results.
limitations: Synthetic performance is not evidence of real-world alpha.
Independent sessions conditional on one model; uncertainty excludes model error.
Exploratory metrics/intervals are not corrected for multiple testing.
Missing metrics are reported with coverage, not replaced by zero.
spec.question: How do unchanged fixed and inventory-aware policies differ under the same weather?
